description:
Presidential Secretariat -Hon. Governors have resigned from their office with effect from May 02, 2024.
Dr. William Wijesinghe Gamage,Mr. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardana
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces the resignations of two named individuals (Dr. William Wijesinghe Gamage and Mr. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardana) from their government positions (Governor of the Southern Province and Governor of the North Western Province). It contains no information about government structural changes or detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities, fitting the criteria for a People Gazette (Type 2).
